newsitem.title: USA: Commerce says merger to hurt net slightly.
newsitem.headline: Commerce says merger to hurt net slightly.

text.p: Commerce Bancorp Inc said Monday its agreement to acquire Independence Bancorp Inc in a stock-swap deal could slightly shrink earnings in the first full year.
The company said the size of the "minimal dilution" to its first full-year earnings would depend on the pace of the expansion plans.
Under the deal, 0.935 share of Commerce Bancorp common stock would be exchanged for each share of Independence common stock.
Based on Commerce's current trading price, the transaction is worth about $25 per share for each Independence share traded, or $76 million, the company said.
The transaction is expected to be completed in the first quarter of 1997.
Independence Bancorp is based in Ramsey, N.J.
